## Intent

What problem does this change solve, and why is this approach appropriate?

## Changes and impact

Describe the changes, affected users or systems, compatibility, and any relevant privacy, security or accessibility impact.

## Evidence

List exact commands, test results, relevant measurements, and checks not run. Link only to evidence that is safe for this repository's visibility.

## Provenance and review

- [ ] I reviewed the change and its dependencies.
- [ ] I have not included secrets, private data or unauthorized materials.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI assistance and verified its output, if applicable.
- [ ] I identified limitations, risks and any required follow-up.

## AI assistance and limitations

Describe material AI assistance, or state none; note any unverified claims or skipped checks.

## Release / rollback considerations

Describe any deployment or rollback impact, or explain why not applicable. This pull request does not itself authorize a release.
